name: com.playtradex.sdk
description:
PlayTradeX SDK 0.5.0-alpha introduces Smart RPC Routing for Unity blockchain applications.

• Successful RPC operation latency measurement
• EMA based RPC latency tracking
• Initial latency sampling across eligible RPC endpoints
• Lowest latency healthy RPC endpoint selection
• Smart routing with automatic failover, cooldown, and endpoint re-entry

samples.description:
PlayTradeX SDK 0.5.0-alpha Smart RPC Routing sample for Unity.

• RPC latency measurement during successful operations
• Initial latency sampling across eligible endpoints
• Lowest latency healthy RPC selection
• Automatic routing away from temporarily unhealthy endpoints
• Automatic return to faster RPC endpoints after recovery
